description: Northern Territory Petroleum and Pipeline Titles is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Mining and Energy. The Department of Mining and Energy stores and manages current and historical mining tenure data within the Northern Territory jurisdiction as part of the provisions of the Mineral Titles Act, Petroleum Act, Energy Pipelines Act, Geothermal Energy Act, and, where applicable, the Commonwealth Aboriginal Land Rights (Northern Territory) Act 1976 (ALRA) and the Native Title ... Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Mining and Energy. Its tags are Boundaries, Economy. It offers 4 resource(s) in html, kml, mapinfo tab, shp. The portal shows 2025-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
